generationRule.note: Reference palettes are adapted, not pixel-identical ports. Verify source licenses before any direct palette import.

licensePolicy.note: Reference source licenses and trademark/attribution terms must be checked at implementation time.

nord.name: Nord
nord.use: cool polar neutral scale and restrained blue accents

solarized.name: Solarized
solarized.use: light/dark luminance relationships and balanced accent roles

catppuccin.name: Catppuccin
catppuccin.use: soft pastel accents and named semantic color roles

dracula.name: Dracula
dracula.use: high-recognition dark accents and explicit theme specification

github-primer.name: GitHub Primer
github-primer.use: functional scales, theme modes, and high-contrast principles

ibm-carbon.name: IBM Carbon
ibm-carbon.use: layered neutral surfaces and white/gray theme architecture

radix.name: Radix Colors
radix.use: 12-step neutral/accent scales and accessible component-state roles

gruvbox.name: Gruvbox
gruvbox.use: warm retro contrast and earthy accents

rose-pine.name: Rosé Pine
rose-pine.use: muted rose, pine, and dawn surface hierarchy

ayu.name: Ayu
ayu.use: dark, mirage, and light mode relationships

kanagawa.name: Kanagawa
kanagawa.use: wave, dragon, and lotus mode relationships

mixed.name: Mixed accessibility references
mixed.use: cross-system neutral and high-contrast design principles
